repair_assessment.anchor: change Requirements 1,4 and Static trigger decisions; upgrade_extensions._static_module_literal / _static_journal_templates
repair_assessment.judgment: Repair explicitly restricts supported grammar and separates absent, invalid and unknown. Invalid grammar refuses without execution; unknown later source skips without execution, while original pre-cutover validated loading/refusal is preserved. Current literal helper is a feasibility precedent, not the new validator: it still accepts duplicate direct assignments and invalid literal strings, which repaired requirements explicitly demand fixing.

Eligibility has direct regular singly linked *.md scope, README exclusion and no recursive scan, content read, links or additional root seam. Existing no-follow descriptor and stat predicates make the selected bounded scope implementable. New presence scan remains unimplemented and unverified.

Journal-only incoming context explicitly spans declaration validation, load and call; shadows incoming top-level module/package names and descendants; gives incoming path precedence; restores module object identities and path and removes introduced affected modules on success/failure. This repairs the demonstrated cached-old baseline without changing generic path helper. Actual older-runner fixture and future restoration remain delivery obligations.

repair_assessment.anchor: change Requirements 2,3,4 and AC-2 through AC-4; upgrade_extensions.pre_docs_gate / _run_journal_pre_migration_hook
repair_assessment.judgment: Plan keeps later hook success independent of builtin pre-1.15 permission, requests once per invocation with hook-owned idempotence, and prohibits rollback promises for partial hook mutation. Current warning promises journals left in place and no retry; repaired documentation/failure AC explicitly requires correcting that claim.

strongest_challenge_response: Fresh execution of actual current hook loader under cached old sibling observed OLD at import and call; uncached control observed INCOMING at both. Repaired journal-context requirement and real older-runner AC-4 directly address this. Current baseline defect is intended implementation work, not evidence that readiness must certify future behavior.
primer_questions_answers: Static decision table now binds grammar/refusal/unknown semantics and prevents later implicit declaration execution; bounded trusted framework read helpers remain permitted while declaration/hook/distribution extension helpers do not execute in preview.

Incoming context must cover transitive and deferred imports at both load and call and restore preexisting module identities on import/call exceptions. Fresh process remains fallback if bounded context cannot prove required origin; no generic plugin loader is authorized.
Presence and legacy builtin gate are independently specified. Hook exception skips dependent migration without claiming rollback; retry is per invocation with idempotent hook-owned work.
